features.note: Correction 2 delivered: the rear latch is now a real DIN spring-clip, not a proud tab. REAR shot reads a fixed hook that returns over itself (the return is what makes it a hook and not a shelf) plus a stepped leaf-spring below it and a screwdriver tab — both extruded profiles. Builder measured hook 26x8x8 mm, leaf 22x29.4x9.9 mm, clip reaches z -0.0753 behind the -0.0679 rear wall. Still no lateral projection. An axis guard was added (extruded parts must be wider in X than Z) to catch the mis-rotated-extrusion failure mode this project has hit before.

Correction 1 delivered: the z-fighting shimmer is GONE. PORT-DETAIL reads 10 clean recessed cavities in 5x2 with crisp module walls and no depth flicker. The builder MEASURED before touching and corrected my diagnosis: the shimmering coincidence was housing_body/port_module_walls FRONT faces coincident on 2805 mm2 (not the shield/wall pair I guessed, whose coincidence was on hidden REAR faces). Fix is physical, not an epsilon: the port block now stands 0.6 mm proud of the housing face (a ganged-connector bezel does stand off its mounting panel), shields got a 0.4 mm standoff, SD lip recessed 0.5 mm. Re-measured zero coincident planes; a permanent verifyNoCoincidentPlanes() guard now runs every build.
Unchanged from blockout and still correct: six-lens system column down the LEFT of the front face, distinct from the per-port bank; ?leds=on energises both. No regression from the structural edits.
Three removable screw-terminal blocks proud of the top face with visible screw heads (3+3+6=12); confirmed from front and rear. No regression.
Placeholder livery massing (red logo patch + white wordmark bars) intact and correctly still deferred to the surface pass for the real CanvasTexture. No regression.
